question: Should OpenClaw permanently add capability-gated append to the built-in write tool and expose optional native append through the Plugin SDK filesystem bridge?
rationale: The implementation can be reviewed mechanically, but automation cannot decide whether this new model-facing behavior and public plugin contract belong in the supported product API.

options.title: Sponsor native append
options.body: Approve both public surfaces, reopen or retain the proposal, and require refreshed exact-head upgrade and real-Docker proof after resolving conflicts.

options.title: Keep append internal
options.body: Permit a core-only implementation while withholding the Plugin SDK capability until a concrete external-plugin requirement establishes the API shape.

options.title: Decline the capability
options.body: Keep overwrite-only write semantics and pursue a different product-level protection against shared-file data loss.

recommendation.title: Sponsor native append
recommendation.body: Approve both public surfaces, reopen or retain the proposal, and require refreshed exact-head upgrade and real-Docker proof after resolving conflicts.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is ownership of the pinned sandbox mutation and security boundary being extended.
